Keywords: Hunnic mounted archery and horse recovery
RagShortTexts: Hunnic mounted archery needs horses, remounts and rest.
Prolonged sieges still need food and special equipment.

Variants.Content: Mounted archery needs horses, remounts and rest. Pursuit wears mounts out; sieges require grain and equipment, so mobility never removes supply needs.

Hunnic mounted archery needs horses, remounts and rest. These forces remain limited by food, rest and loads; vanguard speed does not represent the whole column. Prolonged sieges still need food and special equipment.
